videos.title: My taste and the automated benchmark disagreed almost completely
videos.description: I had both GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 judge the outputs, and neither was spiky enough. They missed things I flagged immediately on a visual pass, like broken prototypes and ignored wireframe constraints. Models can't yet see what a human eye catches in the first screenshot.

videos.title: Task-by-task model recommendations
videos.description: For builders: use GPT-5.5 for PRDs, Sonnet 4.6 for prototypes and chitchat, and Opus 4.8 or Sonnet 5 for codebase navigation. Complex, dense UI work is where Opus 4.8 still earns its price premium; for everything simpler, Sonnet 4.6 holds up.
